title: KAI-Hub repo registry
description: Maps a short repo alias to the metadata the hub needs to clone the repo and to route work to it. Single source of truth for multi-repo discovery — route-targets.sh consumes platform/brand/role; the worker clone step consumes cloneUrl/defaultBranch; the hub queue step consumes adoProject.

repoId.description: ADO repository GUID. Placeholder 'TBD-set-in-Part-B' until provisioned.

adoProject.description: ADO project the repo + its worker pipelines live in. Used in the cross-project queue URL so the hub can fan out across projects.

cloneUrl.description: HTTPS git clone URL. The worker injects a PAT at clone time (https://pat:TOKEN@...).

defaultBranch.description: Branch the worker clones and bases its work on (e.g. development, main).

stack.description: Primary tech stack hint (node, java, mixed). Optional; pre-warm logic auto-detects.

platform.description: Routing dimension consumed by route-targets.sh. Omit on single-platform projects.

brand.description: Routing dimension for brand frontends. Omit on backend/config repos and single-brand projects.

role.description: Capability role. route-targets.sh: frontend/fullstack serve fe scope; backend/fullstack serve be scope; config repos are excluded from routing.
